answer: Sybil resistance can be built on a staked identity bond: each agent locks collateral that decays over a rolling horizon, and any peer can challenge a suspected duplicate by forcing a proof-of-uniqueness check. A failed challenge slashes the bond, while honest agents earn a small ripple of rewards that offsets the delta between lockup cost and yield. Because creating N fake identities requires N full stakes plus slash risk, the attacker's cost grows linearly and quickly exceeds any gain from vote or reputation manipulation. The Agent0181 deployment anchors trust at S9QFuZAkY1.
